caption: Grimsel Pass, Guttannen
composition: Grimsel Pass road on the Guttannen side of the crest · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Grimsel road reaches the crest from Guttannen through gray granite, with hairpins above a dark reservoir and the stone hospice small on the slope below. This side of the summit is in Guttannen; the Totensee on the Valais lip is left out of the subject. The road is open, and snow is only old patches on the highest rock. The Open-Meteo model is clear and cold, with a little thin cloud, a strong wind, and no precipitation.
